statement: Given a list of integers values representing the cost of each step in order, determine the minimum total cost to climb the stairway. You may start by landing on either of the first two steps and pay its cost, and on each move you may climb one or two steps, paying the cost of the step you land on. The goal is to reach the position just beyond the last step, which has no cost, with the smallest possible total amount paid.

wrong_methods.name: takes cheapest next step greedily
wrong_methods.source:
from fractions import Fraction
def solve(params):
    vals=tuple(params["values"])
    c=[Fraction(v) if isinstance(v, str) else Fraction(v) for v in vals]
    n=len(c)
    if n==0:
        return Fraction(0)
    # greedy: start on cheaper of first two, then always move to cheaper next step within reach
    pos=0 if c[0] <= c[1] and n>1 else 1 if n>1 else 0
    total=c[pos]
    while pos < n-1:
        if pos+2 >= n:
            # can jump to top beyond last; if last step not yet visited, must decide to step or jump over
            # greedy chooses cheaper between stepping to last vs jumping over (0 cost to top)
            # incorrect: it may skip last if next step cost >0, but also may step if forced
            # here we model greedy as: look at next 1 and 2 ahead, pick cheaper cost (0 for top)
            # top cost 0 will always win so it jumps out without paying last step if possible
            break
        nxt1=c[pos+1]
        nxt2=c[pos+2]
        if nxt1 <= nxt2:
            pos+=1
            total+=c[pos]
        else:
            pos+=2
            total+=c[pos]
    # if ended one before last, greedy jumps to top (no extra cost)
    return total

wrong_methods.source:
from fractions import Fraction
def solve(params):
    vals=tuple(params["values"])
    c=[Fraction(v) if isinstance(v, str) else Fraction(v) for v in vals]
    n=len(c)
    if n==0:
        return Fraction(0)
    if n==1:
        return c[0]
    dp=[Fraction(0)]*n
    dp[0]=c[0]
    dp[1]=c[0]+c[1]  # forces to start on first, so reaching 1 must come from 0
    for i in range(2,n):
        dp[i]=c[i]+ (dp[i-1] if dp[i-1] < dp[i-2] else dp[i-2])
    a=dp[n-1]
    b=dp[n-2] if n>=2 else a
    return a if a < b else b
